newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch closing debt market report.
newsitem.headline: Dutch closing debt market report.

text.p: Dutch bonds handed back some of their earlier gains on Friday, but closed somewhat higher.

Dealers said guilder bonds were likely to slip in the next few sessions along with bunds as market was not attracting many buyers ahead of Christmas and some said players might cash in some of their profits near the year-end.
The January 2006 bond rose 0.20 to 101.90/98, with a bid yield of 5.72 percent versus 5.75 percent on Thursday.
The 10-year yield spread versus the April 2006 bund widened to minus 10 basis points from minus 9 on Thursday, but dealers were expecting the gap to narrow to about minus seven again.
